title: Troublemakers Are Disliked Ones!
body:
Dastoor yaa Sayyidee. (Mawlana Shaykh stands) Laa ilaaha illa-Llah. Laa ilaaha illa-Llah. Laa ilaaha illa-Llah
Muhammadun Rasoolullah `alayhi salaatullah min al-azali ila 'l-abad. Zidhu yaa Rabbee `izzan wa sharafan
nooran wa surooran, ridwaanan wa sultaanan. Raghman `alaa anfi 's-salafiyeen. Thumma as-salaat wa 'ssalaam `alaa jamee`i 'l-anbiyaa wa 'l-mursaleen wa man tabi`ahum bi `ihsan ila yawmi 'd-deen. A`oodhu
billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem!
Say, our attenders, say, Salafi `ulamas, Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem! That is an honor for us. You must
stand up and you must say! (Mawlana Shaykh sits)
O our Attenders! Marhaban! As-salaamu `alaykum! Don't run away, then heavenly ones will send after you
Shaytan's dogs to bite you. Shaytan has countless dogs. Those who are not attending, one day coming, and
second day not coming are leaving those dogs to bite them. That is also a heavenly warning to those people
who are not giving a short time for listening to heavenly warnings. Daily we have heavenly warnings. The
Lord of Heavens, Allah (swt), (Mawlana Shaykh stands) is not leaving. Wa dhakkir, "And remind!" That is a
heavenly warning! (Mawlana Shaykh sits)
A heavenly warning is coming. Sometimes people are writing on some places, what is that writing, do you

know? "Mind your head." Yes, is it so? "Mind your head." What does it mean? There is always that writing,
"Mind your heads," because something may touch you and you may be hurt. In some places there is also
some writing on some doors, saying, "Beware of dog." Where is the dog? Sitting inside, hiding itself, but if
anyone is asking to enter, it is standing up and rushing on him! Therefore, that is always written in, "Beware
of dog." And who is the biggest dog, the biggest harmful one for Mankind, who is that one? Diabolo, Shaytan.
O `ulamas Salaafiyeen! Are you reminding people daily, "O People! Beware of Shaytan!" Are you doing this?
No! You must do it, because the holy order is, fasta`eedhu billah.
•••••••• •••••••••••• •••• •••••••••••• •••••• ••••••••••• ••••••••
Wa imma yanzaghannaka mina 'sh-shaytaani nazghun fasta`ith billaahi. If a suggestion from Satan assail thy
(mind), seek refuge with Allah. (al-A`araf, 7:200)
Shaytan is always asking to catch you to give trouble to you. I am asking a question to Salafi `ulamas,
marhaban! Hear! Who is the biggest troublemaker on Earth? Say its name and print it and you must say who
is this biggest troublemaker.
If a teacher enters a classroom, he knows which one of the students is a troublemaker. He also knows which
one is the most biggest troublemaker. Yes. And this is a good question for waking up believers, not to fall in
the traps of that biggest harming one, or troublemaker. Always the biggest troublemaker is sending east and
west, and everywhere its soldiers and followers, sending to make Mankind to fall into trouble. Who is that
one? Say! If you are Salafi `ulamas, you must know this! Who is the biggest troublemaker on Earth? If you do
not know, you are going to be ignorant ones. And the Lord of Heavens is ordering to you, O `ulamas, "Warn
My servants not to fall into the traps of the biggest enemy of Mankind." Say! Don't claim, "We are Salafi
`ulamas," or, "We are doctors," no, leave that! I am asking, because you are on the level that you must wake
people up!
O People! Wake up! Because your biggest enemy is just putting countless trips, and beware, don't fall in its
trap! The biggest troublemaker is asking you to follow it and to come in sewage channels, nothing else.
Shaytan is asking from Mankind to follow him, for what? To bring them to sewage channels--dirty life, full
with troubles! When Man is falling in troubles, Shaytan is getting so happy! Beware of Shaytan! Say! You are
`ulamas! Hadhhar, beware of dog. In Arabic, fahzhar min ash-Shaytan. We are in need of that daily. Daily

you must say this. We must try to wake people up, "O People! In front of you is danger!"
Once upon a time I was in Lebanon, and that biggest troublemaker for Mankind was making troubles. When
we were coming from Damascus to Beirut, there is a place named Minya, where sometimes armed people
stand there, warning, "Don't go further, because there is shooting," so people will not be hurt. And now
Shaytan is everywhere, shooting people! Why are you not warning people, "Don't go to that place, don't do
this and that, because Shaytan and its armies may shoot you down and troubles may reach you!" You must
teach people, particularly youngsters, as it is so easy for them to follow Shaytan. Youngsters are ready for
following Shaytan and its followers. Why are you not writing in your schools, "O Students! Don't be
troublemakers." If he is a troublemaker, take that troublemaker out. Don't leave troublemakers between
students. That is Shaytan's representative. Look in your classroom among students, if you are looking and
seeing a troublemaker, take his name and send him away. Because he is troublemaker, representative of
Shaytan, making trouble for other school students, no!
Therefore, troublemakers are disliked ones. And from their faces you can understand that they are
troublemakers. Send them away! Clean schools, clean universities, clean armies, and clean factories from
troublemakers. Don't make it like this, no. Everywhere troublemakers must be taken away! That is salaamatu
'l-insaan, safety for Mankind. Don't give that one a chance to make trouble. If you are looking and seeing that
they did trouble in schools, academies, universities, factories, or armies once, take them away! That is
salaamat ad-dunya, salaamatu 'l-insaan, safety and peace.
It is most important for governments to look after troublemakers. If you are looking and seeing someone that
is getting first and shouting, that means he is a chief of troublemakers, no one else, catch him. Who is
number one for asking to make shouting and bringing that, take them, other people, don't worry! Take who is
the head of this or that movement, who is chief for troublemakers.
That is important for all nations and it is written in holy books, the Old Testament, the New Testament, the
Psalms of David (a) and the Holy Qur'an, saying, "Don't leave troublemakers on power, take them away!" At
least you may take them and put them in unknown deserts, leave them there! Don't leave any troublemakers
in villages, in towns, in cities, in parliament, in government, in armies, in the Navy, or in markets, no! They
are the biggest reason for cursing on Mankind and making the life of Mankind poisoned. You may know, take

them away from people! If anyone is making trouble, take him and put him out, they are making the life of
Mankind poisoned.
And I am asking from Salafi `ulamas, who is the biggest troublemaker? Say its name! You know. If you don't
know, you are not an `alim. Who was the biggest troublemaker, munafiqoon, hypocrite and they have been
taken away? Everywhere troublemakers must be taken away. If we are asking for peace on Earth, we must
run after troublemakers, to collect them and put them in unknown places or deserts or put them on an island
that it is impossible for them to come back. Say its name, you Salafi `ulamas, the biggest harmful and biggest
reason for cursing and the biggest troublemaker for Mankind! Why are you not saying that it is Shaytan? The
biggest troublemaker is Shaytan. All wars happened and finally the First World War, and Second World War,
from where was it coming? The first class troublemaker, the representative of Shaytan or dictators! They did
their worst for Mankind and in the first war just killed 20 million people and in the second war a billion
people just passed away by the order of Shaytan's successors, or Shaytan's representatives.
Look, O Mankind! You must listen to the holy commands from the Heavens! The Heavens are ordering you to
take away troublemakers! Don't leave them to live among you. They are more dangerous than the pig flu!
Thousands and thousands of times more harmful are those troublemakers. They are tyrants, and through
their commands millions and millions of innocent ones were killed in Russia, China, India, Turkey, Europe,
east and west. You are writing in your history books, they are saying, I am not saying from myself, Allah
Almighty is never giving a chance for a troublemaker to kill one innocent one, yes. For what were they
making that trouble? Because they are agents of Shaytan and until we are learning this, never-ending
troubles will continue, never-ending battles and wars will continue and people will be in never-ending traps
of Shaytan, falling in and never tasting a sweet life on Earth and to be in safety after this life. May Allah
forgive us.
O our Attenders! Take your lesson, don't leave troublemakers among you because troublemakers are
representatives of the biggest troublemaker, Shaytan. May Allah forgive us. Open your eyes before you fall
down! Don't be blind ones to realities. That is advice from the Heavens to all nations. If you like it, accept. If
you do not like this advice, you may fall down and you will cry but it is going to be useless. May Allah forgive
us for the honor of these holy days and for the honor of the most honored one, (Mawlana Shaykh stands)
Sayyidina Muhammad (s). (Mawlana Shaykh sits)

Fatihah.
(33 minutes)
(Mawlana Shaykh speaks to Shaykh Hisham Effendi on the phone.)
(Shaykh Hisham: Allahu Akbar `ala man tajabbar wa takabbar, "God is most great on those who are tyrants!"
Today I never saw you using such strong language on anyone. I am in New York with Hajjah Naziha, and we
have hundreds of people here watching you on the Sufilive TV--Jews, Christians and from every nation--they
are watching from all kinds of heads of different groups who came from many different religious faiths and
watching you. They want to take baya`, Sayyidee, if you can recite the verse of baya`, jamu`n ghafir, for a
large gathering.)
(Mawlana Shaykh recites the verse of baya` and says they will be successful and victorious against Shaytan
and his works.)
(Mawlana Shaykh prays two raka`at Salaat ash-Shukr.)
